catalog.empty: Nothing found. Try another search or fewer filters.
catalog.quickFilters: Places and equipment — scroll for all options
catalog.filterLogic: Any selected option within a group can match. All groups must match. Muscles refer to the primary load.
catalog.equipmentLogic: Equipment: exercises using at least one selected item. Other equipment may also be needed — check the exercise details.

exercise.machineTranslation: Machine translation. You can help improve it on GitHub.
exercise.issueHint: Opens a GitHub form with the exercise name and your description. A GitHub account is required; review the form before submitting.

video.title: Video
video.externalSearch: — YouTube search, opens in a new tab

programs.title: Programs
programs.emptyText: Build your own from scratch or pick a ready-made template.
programs.firstProgramHint: Create your first program with this exercise in its first day. Then add more exercises and customize your program.
programs.supersetRest: Rest comes after the last exercise of the superset
programs.weekdaysHint: On these days the workout waits on the home screen, one tap to start.
programs.fromScratchHint: An empty program to fill yourself
programs.autosaved: Changes are saved automatically on this device
programs.durationHint: Includes rest, excludes warm-up. Estimate: 3–5 seconds per rep; 20–45 seconds for open-ended sets.
programs.templateAdapt: A starting point: after adding, adjust the exercises, sets and targets to your experience.

scheme.progressionReps: All sets done for {{n}} reps — next time the weight goes up {{inc}} kg.
scheme.progressionRange: Add a rep per set until all sets reach {{b}}. Then +{{inc}} kg and back to {{a}}.
scheme.progressionDeload: {{n}} failed workouts in a row at the same weight — the weight drops {{pct}}%.

explain.amrap: AMRAP — as many quality reps as possible while maintaining form.
explain.max: Max — maximum reps in a set; log the actual result.

share.title: Share program
share.brokenHint: It may have been cut off by a messenger. Ask for the link again or use the QR code.
share.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the content and copy it manually.
share.copyHint: The link contains the program. The recipient saves their own copy.
share.shareFailed: Could not share. Copy the text manually.

setTypeHint.work: Counts towards volume, records and auto-progression.
setTypeHint.warmup: Saved in history. Does not count towards volume, records or auto-progression; no rest timer.
setTypeHint.drop: Counts towards volume and records. Excluded from auto-progression.
setTypeHint.failure: Counts towards volume, records and auto-progression. Effort is logged separately.

workout.setDetailsHint: Tap a set number to change its type or log RPE / RIR.
workout.rirHint: Reps left in reserve: 0–10. Zero means no reps left.
workout.replaceHint: For the remaining sets in this workout. Completed sets stay with the original exercise. Weight comes from the selected exercise’s history; otherwise, enter it again.
workout.noReplacement: No matching alternatives. Select other available equipment or change your search.
workout.title: Workout
workout.confirmDiscard: Discard this workout? Logged sets will be lost.
workout.replaceActive: A workout is already in progress. Replace it?
workout.confirmFinish: {{done}} of {{total}} sets completed. Save completed sets and finish? You can resume the remaining plan from the history record.
workout.confirmRemoveExercise: This exercise has completed sets. Delete the exercise and its results?
workout.confirmRemoveSet: This set is completed. Delete its result?
workout.confirmFinishEmpty: None of {{total}} sets completed. Finish without a history record? The current plan will be removed.
workout.freeHint: Add exercises as you go. No prepared plan needed.
workout.bodyweightHint: Bodyweight — no need to enter your body mass.
workout.addedWeightHint: Weight here means added resistance, excluding body mass.

journal.title: Progress
journal.empty: Finished workouts will show up here.
journal.noRecords: Log sets with weight to see your records.
journal.periodCompare: Last 28 days: {{recent}}; {{change}} compared with the previous 28 days.
journal.editSessionHint: Edit results, set type, RPE / RIR or notes. The workout date and remaining plan are preserved.
journal.editConflict: This workout changed while editing. Close and reopen the editor.
journal.confirmResume: Reopen this workout? Completed sets are preserved. Until you finish again, the record will be available in the active workout.
journal.resumeUnavailable: Finish or discard the current workout first.
journal.firstHint: Finish your first workout to see your history, muscle load and changes in performance.

progress.empty: No logged sets for this exercise yet.
progress.oneEntry: One workout so far. Log another result to compare.

calc.title: Calculators
calc.remainder: {{n}} kg can't be loaded with your plates
calc.bmiNote: BMI doesn't account for muscle mass — athletes often score "overweight".

more.defaultRestHint: Used for exercises added to a workout without a program, and for the first exercise of a new program. In a program, rest is set per exercise; during a workout, tap the rest time on an exercise to change it.
more.title: More
more.dataHint: Programs, history, measurements and photos are stored only in this browser. Export a backup to move them to another device.
more.imported: Imported {{programs}} programs, {{sessions}} workouts and {{measurements}} measurement entries
more.exportFailed: Could not create a backup. Check browser storage access.
more.mergeFailed: Could not merge data. Check free space and try importing again.
more.importFailed: This file is not a fitnoss backup
more.offlineHint: Exercise data is available offline already. Download all photos (~100 MB) to browse everything without internet.
more.backupContents: Includes programs, completed workouts, favorites, body measurements and their photos. Settings and the active workout are excluded.
more.mergeHint: New records will be added. Existing records with the same ID are kept unchanged; favorites are merged.
more.importPreview: New programs: {{programs}}, workouts: {{sessions}}, measurement entries: {{measurements}}. Already present: {{existing}}. Favorites in file: {{favorites}}.
more.offlinePartial: {{downloaded}} of {{total}} files available; {{failed}} failed. Retry the download.
more.offlineFailed: Could not download photos. Check your connection and retry.
more.offlineStatus: Last check: {{downloaded}} of {{total}} files available, {{failed}} failed

about.title: About
about.text: fitnoss is a free exercise library, program builder and training log. No sign-up, no ads.
about.privacy: Everything you create stays in your browser. Share links carry the program itself, nothing is sent to a server.
about.videos: Videos are embedded from YouTube and belong to their authors.
about.license: fitnoss is open source under the MIT license. See
about.disclaimer: The information here is not medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting a new training program and stop if you feel pain.

home.scheduleHint: Assign weekdays to your program days, and today's workout starts with one tap.

body.title: Weight and measurements
body.emptyHint: Log your weight or body measurements to follow changes. You can also add a photo.
body.noMetric: No entries for this measurement yet. Add it to a new or existing entry.
body.valuesHint: Enter the measurements you want to track or add a photo. You can leave the other fields empty.
body.invalidValues: Enter values greater than zero: weight up to 1000 kg, measurements up to 500 cm.
body.photoFailed: Could not open the photo. Choose an image under 20 MB in a browser-supported format, such as JPEG or PNG.
body.confirmDelete: Delete this entry and its photo?
body.saveFailed: Could not save changes. Check free space and browser storage access.
body.storageFailed: Could not open measurements. Allow browser storage and try again.
body.localHint: Measurements and photos stay in this browser. They are included in your backup in Settings → Your data.

programVolume.weeklyHint: Coverage across the whole program’s weekly schedule.
programVolume.cycleHint: Coverage for one pass through every program day.
programVolume.missing: Exercises missing from the catalogue: {{count}}. Their sets are not included.

muscleMap.title: Muscles this week
muscleMap.hint: Color shows completed sets where the muscle is a primary mover. Indirect sets are listed separately; warmups are excluded.
muscleMap.empty: No sets logged this week yet. Save a workout to see your muscle volume here.
